name: Personal agent current work and next actions
summary: Personal attention retains bounded work snapshots. Only blockers/dependencies block undelivered work; delivered review takes precedence. Every own queue row carries whose_move (a caller-relative move token) and next, one sentence from the validated review state: changes requested is the caller's work until it delivers a revision that supersedes the contribution and answers each item, and a delivered unanswered revision owes only the responses; review and integration belong to the reviewer or the coordinator; a caller whose own checkpoint records a blocker or dependency is quoted in its own words, escaped, with no person inferred, and the move stays the caller's. One decision gives all three of whose_move, next and next_actor, the caller-neutral role of that decision (never null; operator for a malformed row); the next-actions answer carries whose_move/next only where the kind is changes-requested. Own-move items sort first; top-level your_move counts every reconciled row, not the page. A claimable suggestion is the one bounded rule: an epic, decision, gate, job, record anchor or task labelled decision is never offered. Flagged in-progress tasks sort first before the action cap.
